pulse.text: **xAI shipped Grok Imagine Image 2.0 on Aug 7** — its first new model of any kind since Grok 4.5 — a rebuilt image generator with region-level editing, segmentation and background removal that debuts **second in the world in both Arena image categories** (1439 Elo on Image Edit, 1320 on text-to-image), behind OpenAI's gpt-image-2 in each. Backfilled alongside it: **Mistral's Shieldstral**, a 3B Apache-2.0 multimodal safety classifier from Aug 4 that takes moderation policy as plain-language questions at inference time, runs on one 16GB GPU, and which Mistral says matches guard models seven times its size. The louder story is still OpenAI's — after telling Axios it **cannot rule out critical cyber capabilities** in Astra, the lab now signals the model may have reached that threshold outright, and the market flinched: Polymarket's Sep 15 leg slid to **50% from 53%** while Sep 30 held flat at 88%. Standings are unchanged, with Claude Opus 5 at #1 and Anthropic priced at **92%** to own the best model at the end of August (84% for September). Smaller drift elsewhere: Gemini 3.5 Pro nudged up to 59% by Aug 31, GPT-6's year-end leg eased to 88%, the next Mythos-class model's Sep 15 leg fell to 40% from 43%, and Manifold's AGI-before-2028 line jumped to **17% from 13%**. Watch Alibaba next — the Qwen3.8-Max open weights are still slated for the week of Aug 10, and **Grok 4.6 still does not exist** in xAI's own docs, whose model list tops out at grok-4.5.
